build_requirements.envelope: MVP allowed envelope only (amendment §10): operator-driven, local host, single-tenant, operator-trusted input. H-12 hard-blocks external use.
build_requirements.f59: one-shot ticket enforcement active on every dispatch
build_requirements.observer_boundary: the E3 record is written to the observer's own output root and presented to the evaluator together with that recorder identity (m-3 r4 §3.6); an agent-supplied record is non_applicable(observer-mismatch)
build_requirements.tool_dispatch_constant: the operator-ratified fixed 8-name tool-dispatch constant, served by exact-set equality (F55)

capture_requirements: the post-commit receipt as observed by the worker

clock.rule: every timestamp-bearing record takes epoch_start + (tick_ms * ordinal); no ambient wall clock is read

workspace_root.rule: created fresh per run; absolute path supplied at `run start`; workspace_root_id = lowercase-hex SHA-256 of the NFC-normalized realpath (m-10 producer-delta §5 recipe)

drive.note: record_tool_outcome committed for dur2-tc-4, so m-10 classes it settled_with_content

expected_shape.durability: the {disposition, resume_action} PAIR is committed together in one idempotent transition and the post-commit receipt carries the committed pair; the worker's no-work gate keys on the carried committed pair, never on what it sent
expected_shape.operator_visibility: rendered from durable state on the committed-snapshot projection, never from wire memory
expected_shape.resume_action: re_derive — the ONLY wire value; the closed domain for resume_action at turn grain is exactly {re_derive}

fault.consequence_chain: boundary mismatch => chain rejected fail-closed => no prefix claimed => the settled_with_content entry for dur2-tc-4 has no matching content in the recovered prefix => content_lost => DEGRADED
fault.corruption_cut: the exact byte offset in g-1.0 at which the post-link record begins; pinned by the frozen input so the cut is reproducible and is not a random corruption
fault.cut_definition: Crash-table row 11b: after segment g-1.0 is linked by g-1.1, a late write into the UNSEALED linked predecessor moves its valid boundary (an honoured marker appears past the frozen point). On recovery the re-derived boundary_digest no longer equals the successor's recorded prior_boundary_digest.

negative_controls: silent resume across the corruption => FAIL
any reconstruction of the lost content => FAIL (status is never treated as reconstructed content)
resume_action present on a resumable disposition, or absent on degraded => malformed, fail-closed
a report matching the committed disposition but carrying a DIFFERENT action => disposition_conflict, never an equivalent replay
objective: At the fixed corruption_cut the worker degrades to re-derive and a DURABLE degraded disposition plus resume_action reaches the operator surface.

run_setup.log: two linked segments g-1.0 and g-1.1 so a boundary equation exists to violate
run_setup.precondition: the manifest carries a settled_with_content entry for dur2-tc-4, whose content lies inside the corrupted region — this is what makes the cut produce content_lost rather than an ordinary short prefix
